_mrPya5SXSqW.name: Deadly
_mrPya5SXSqW.description: Assign each wound to one model, and multiply it by X. Hits from Deadly must be resolved first, and these wounds don’t carry over to other models if the original target is killed.

_T07iXWo4VwJ.name: Parry
_T07iXWo4VwJ.description: When this unit takes hits in melee from enemies charging it in the front, roll X dice per model with this rule in it, up to as many dice as hits taken. For each 6+ one hit is ignored (defender picks which).

-QJdqJEKjIpE.name: Flying
-QJdqJEKjIpE.description: May move through units and terrain, and ignores the effects of Difficult and Dangerous terrain.

0bcGY4Xr4NE0.name: Brace
0bcGY4Xr4NE0.description: Enemies charging this unit get -X total Impact rolls per model with this rule in the two front rows if charging in the front, unless this unit is Fatigued.

0dZak5jae8F0.name: Melee Shrouding Aura
0dZak5jae8F0.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Melee Shrouding. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

17crjK7P6_w6.name: AP
17crjK7P6_w6.description: Targets get -X to Defense rolls when blocking hits.

1TMBPe40kx2b.name: Melee Shrouding
1TMBPe40kx2b.description: When a unit where most models have this rule is targeted by an enemy unit for charging, that enemy unit gets -2" range to a min. of 6".

2atvlmICQSCV.name: Fearless
2atvlmICQSCV.description: When a unit where most models have this rule fails a Morale Test, roll one die. On a 4+ it counts as passed instead.

3FeiOe3krHMa.name: Aircraft
3FeiOe3krHMa.description: May only use Advance actions, moving in a straight line, and adding 30” to its total move (even if Shaken). Aircraft ignore all units and terrain when moving and stopping, can’t seize or contest objectives, can’t be charged, and units targeting them get -12” range and -1 to hit rolls.

47CAqf7ySlfc.name: Caster
47CAqf7ySlfc.description: Gets X spell tokens at the start of each round, but can’t have more than 6 at once. Once per activation, before attacking, spend as many tokens as the spell’s value to try casting one or more spells (only one try per spell). Pick a target and roll one die, and on 4+ resolve the spell’s effect. Models within 18” of the Caster may spend any number of spell tokens at the same time before rolling to give the Caster +1/-1 to the roll per token.

5v6oaGfrdf29.name: Surge
5v6oaGfrdf29.description: For each unmodified result of 6 to hit, this weapon deals 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

62-mYKVM9MLd.name: Impact
62-mYKVM9MLd.description: When charging, before either unit attacks, models in the two front rows roll X dice, unless this unit is Fatigued. For each 2+ the target takes 1 hit.

6mJw5IdqSqNC.name: Ambush
6mJw5IdqSqNC.description: May be set aside before deployment. At the start of any round after the first, may be deployed within 1” of any table edge, over 9" away from enemy units. Players alternate in placing Ambush units, starting with the player that activates next. Units that deploy via Ambush can’t seize or contest objectives on the round they deploy.

741uN_Qma5mL.name: Battleborn
741uN_Qma5mL.description: If a unit where most models have this rule is Shaken at the beginning of the round, roll one die. On a 4+, it stops being Shaken.

8Ck9GAwUK824.name: Indirect
8Ck9GAwUK824.description: When using Hold actions and shooting, may target enemies that are not in line of sight as if in line of sight, and ignores Cover from Sight Blockers.

8Hjy54TYtwb7.name: Takedown
8Hjy54TYtwb7.description: This model may pick any model in the target unit as its individual target for this weapon's attacks, which is resolved as if it was a unit of [1]. Takedown attacks must be resolved before other weapons.

8KujvrTG8k9p.name: Regeneration
8KujvrTG8k9p.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

9042COVrLCsI.name: Limited
9042COVrLCsI.description: May only be used once per game.

9jyvRoBODD-O.name: Stealth
9jyvRoBODD-O.description: When units where most models have this rule are shot from over 9" away, enemy units get -1 to hit rolls.

9o03izVMZ-Xl.name: Smash
9o03izVMZ-Xl.description: When attacking units over half of this weapon's range away, the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6.

a0YtInGiUDd6.name: Tough
a0YtInGiUDd6.description: Once a model has taken as many wounds as its Tough value, it is killed (remove from play).

aogQZcOOQrDI.name: Transport
aogQZcOOQrDI.description: May transport up to X friendly models or Heroes with up to Tough(6), and non-Heroes with up to Tough(3) which occupy 3 spaces each. Transports may deploy with units inside, and units may enter/exit by using any move action, getting within 2” to enter, and staying fully within 6” when exiting. Units inside/outside transports may not target other units that are outside/inside, but may target the transport itself. When a transport is destroyed, units inside must take a Dangerous Terrain Test, are Shaken, and must be placed fully within 6” of the transport before it’s removed.

ayuikxkmDOmq.name: Versatile Reach Aura
ayuikxkmDOmq.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Versatile Reach. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

ba6LlbpoLkSu.name: Bane when Shooting Aura
ba6LlbpoLkSu.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Bane on its weapons when shooting. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

c45Fw0D2oGOk.name: Counter
c45Fw0D2oGOk.description: May strike first with this weapon when charged, unless this unit is Fatigued.

cavWDboL4ubs.name: Rending
cavWDboL4ubs.description: Ignores Regeneration, and for each unmodified result of 6 to hit, those hits get AP(+4).

dIQ3SGl2J2Ew.name: Fear
dIQ3SGl2J2Ew.description: When in melee with this model, enemies count as having taken +X wounds when checking who won.

FAMbscK5vhSu.name: Scout
FAMbscK5vhSu.description: May be set aside before deployment. After all other units are deployed, may be deployed anywhere fully within 9” of their deployment zone, over 9” away from non-Scout enemy units. Players alternate in placing Scout units, starting with the player that activates next.

FF5ddXgx75lI.name: Assault
FF5ddXgx75lI.description: Counts as both a ranged weapon and a melee weapon.

FRVSAjasmFSF.name: Bravery Aura
FRVSAjasmFSF.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get +1 to Morale Test rolls. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

GRuFoZiyjY5f.name: Artillery
GRuFoZiyjY5f.description: When this model uses Hold actions and shoots at enemies over 12” away, it gets +1 to hit rolls. If most models in this unit have this rule, as long as they haven't moved during this round, enemy units shooting at them from over 12” away get -1 to hit rolls.

H9E9PIWpGRdw.name: Relentless
H9E9PIWpGRdw.description: When this model shoots at enemies over 9” away, unmodified result of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

IEJp3a4vE0CB.name: Shred
IEJp3a4vE0CB.description: For each unmodified result of 1 to block hits, this weapon deals 1 extra wound.

j93FkLXMCk8v.name: Steadfast
j93FkLXMCk8v.description: If a unit where most models have this rule is Shaken at the beginning of the round, roll one die. On a 4+, it stops being Shaken.

JoOCVPx1xT1G.name: Furious
JoOCVPx1xT1G.description: When charging, unmodified result of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

JSKVyurtWIyW.name: Strider
JSKVyurtWIyW.description: May ignore the effects of Difficult terrain.

KdgwlPb8LuD2.name: Fast
KdgwlPb8LuD2.description: Moves +2” when using Advance, and +4” when using Rush/Charge.

Ldhtmr4H8b6G.name: Slow
Ldhtmr4H8b6G.description: Moves -2” when using Advance, and -4” when using Rush/Charge.

mETdyZ__yMVj.name: Mend
mETdyZ__yMVj.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly model within 3" with Tough, and remove D3 wounds from it.

Naqc5mga9Uha.name: Bane
Naqc5mga9Uha.description: Ignores Regeneration, and when attacking, the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6.

O_sf2rsHA7rD.name: Evasive
O_sf2rsHA7rD.description: Enemies get -1 to hit rolls when attacking units where most models have this rule.

qrG_DXJez5Dg.name: Musician
qrG_DXJez5Dg.description: This model and its unit moves +1" when using move actions.

qsx__9Cz3au_.name: Rapid Rush
qsx__9Cz3au_.description: This model moves +6" when using Rush actions.

QXyt-zV_bjpg.name: Unstoppable
QXyt-zV_bjpg.description: This weapon ignores Regeneration, and ignores all negative modifiers which are not from this model's special rules.

RDFhn43ktRx8.name: Rapid Rush Aura
RDFhn43ktRx8.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Rapid Rush. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

s6MgSfmgylXU.name: Defense
s6MgSfmgylXU.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

T08VkBuVmNZ_.name: Hero
T08VkBuVmNZ_.description: Heroes with up to Tough(6) may deploy as part of one multi-model unit without another Hero, but must use the unit’s Defense until all other models have been killed. The Hero’s unit, and units within 6” of friendly Heroes with Tough(9) or higher, may use the Hero’s Quality for Morale Tests as long as the Hero isn’t Shaken.

umbiz4tnEyF8.name: Thrust
umbiz4tnEyF8.description: When charging, gets +1 to hit rolls and AP(+1) in melee.

V3YzPPkZm8at.name: Regeneration Aura
V3YzPPkZm8at.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Regeneration. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

w_vX0mi58KKt.name: Blast
w_vX0mi58KKt.description: Ignores Cover, and after resolving other special rules, each hit is multiplied by X, where X is up to as many hits as models in the target unit.

XoDRL2xVEnVf.name: Bane in Melee Aura
XoDRL2xVEnVf.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Bane on its weapons in melee. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

y47PXwakTSji.name: Versatile Reach
y47PXwakTSji.description: When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation, all models with this rule in this unit either get +4" range when shooting or move +2" when charging.

ywXKQKPOLjTF.name: Banner
ywXKQKPOLjTF.description: This model and its unit get +1 to Morale Test rolls triggered by shooting/melee.

z4QuSO_AxqDr.name: Versatile Expert
z4QuSO_AxqDr.description: When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation all models with this rule in this unit either get AP(+1) when attacking, or get +1 to hit rolls when attacking.

zjzB46LX-QDg.name: Re-Deployment
zjzB46LX-QDg.description: After all other units are deployed (excluding units that were set aside), you may remove up to two friendly units from the table and deploy them again. Players alternate in placing Re-Deployment units, starting with the player that activates next.

0IRkW.name: Psychic Terror
0IRkW.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 6", which takes 3 hits with Bane.

98xBf.name: Lightning Fog
98xBf.effect: Pick up to two enemy units within 9", which take 4 hits each.

c19YO.name: Advanced Sight
c19YO.effect: Pick up to two enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Unstoppable on their weapons when shooting against once (next time the effect would apply).

iBpcF.name: Blessed Ammo
iBpcF.effect: Pick up to three friendly units within 18", which get Shred on its weapons when shooting once (next time the effect would apply).

IiOah.name: Cerebral Trauma
IiOah.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 24" in line of sight, which takes 6 hits with AP(1) and Smash.

L_-cl.name: Protective Dome
L_-cl.effect: Pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Evasive once (next time the effect would apply).
